from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485207/attempts/aebe2cf00e3243528294ba8447492ab6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # The template ends immediately before the all-zero separator column.
    split = next((c for c in range(1, w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))), w)
    left = [row[:split] for row in grid]
    width = split
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == bg for v in left[r])]
    panels = [(a, b) for a, b in zip(separators, separators[1:]) if b > a + 1]

    # Read each colored shape on the right as a tight binary mask.
    seen = set()
    shapes = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(split, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color in (0, bg) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and split <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
            r0, r1 = min(x for x,y in cells), max(x for x,y in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(y for x,y in cells), max(y for x,y in cells)
            mask = [[0]*(c1-c0+1) for _ in range(r1-r0+1)]
            for rr,cc in cells: mask[rr-r0][cc-c0] = 1
            shapes.append((color, mask))

    for color, mask in shapes:
        mh, mw = len(mask), len(mask[0])
        placed = False
        for top, bottom in panels:
            # Separator rows form the panel frame; object sits between them.
            for r0 in range(top+1, bottom-mh+1):
                for c0 in range(width-mw+1):
                    if all(mask[dr][dc] == 0 or left[r0+dr][c0+dc] == 0
                           for dr in range(mh) for dc in range(mw)):
                        # Require exact agreement with all holes in the placed bbox.
                        if all((left[r0+dr][c0+dc] == 0) == bool(mask[dr][dc])
                               for dr in range(mh) for dc in range(mw)):
                            for dr in range(mh):
                                for dc in range(mw):
                                    if mask[dr][dc]: left[r0+dr][c0+dc] = color
                            placed = True
                            break
                if placed: break
            if placed: break
    return left
'''
p=programs/'task-eb825ab9.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'), globals())
